# Kumar S. — Creative Director Portfolio

## Overview

Kumar S. is a creative director with 6+ years of experience. The portfolio brings together visual storytelling across film, motion, 3D, and digital culture.

## Creative disciplines

- Video editing
- Motion graphics
- AI filmmaking
- Blender 3D
- Social media storytelling

## Site sections

- `/` — portfolio homepage
- `/about` — approach and disciplines
- `/projects` — visual work archive
- `/contact` — project inquiry form

## Archive note

The archive displays clearly labeled temporary visual studies until original project artwork and descriptions are added. These placeholders are not client projects, endorsements, or performance claims.
